notes: IMDwindowshopper (WWW): Stop window shopping. See everything first. @windowshoppermd. WindowShopperToken (src/WindowShopperToken.sol) is a plain OpenZeppelin v5.1.0 ERC20 with no constructor arguments. Its constructor mints the whole fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 WWW (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units, 18 decimals) once to msg.sender, which at launch is the IMD ProjectFactory; the factory distributes it (10% to the launch's MerkleDistributor, 50% seeds the single-sided pool, 40% to economics.remainderTo). There is no owner or admin: no mint, pause, blacklist, freeze, seize, burnFrom or upgrade path, so the supply can never grow and nobody but a holder or an approved spender can move a holder's balance. Transfers move exactly the amount they name (no fee, tax, burn, reflection or limit), so the swarm share, the pool seed and swaps through the Uniswap v4 PoolManager arrive whole. The token makes no external calls and its runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. There are no application contracts. The pool pairs with IMD (0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7) on Ethereum at the launch policy fee of 1.25% with tick spacing 60; pool.initialPrice is provenance only, the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei (900 IMD for the whole supply) and totalSupply.
